name: AmcacheParser
description: Parse Amcache.hve and export the program, driver, device and file records it holds as CSV.
about: Amcache.hve is a registry hive Windows maintains about software, drivers and devices that have been present on a system. AmcacheParser reads it and writes each category to its own CSV: unassociated file entries, program entries and the file entries belonging to them, device containers, device PnP records, drivers and shortcuts. Many file entries carry the SHA-1 the hive recorded, so results can be narrowed against a list of hashes to include or exclude, with exclusions taking precedence. Transaction logs sitting beside a dirty hive are replayed before parsing unless that is turned off.
